Bengaluru launches safe footpath campaign with road safety initiative

Bengaluru is set to launch a 'Safe Footpath Campaign' starting July 1. The initiative is part of a broader Rs 70 crore road safety push aimed at improving pedestrian infrastructure. The campaign focuses on ensuring safer pathways for citizens in the city.
